question.question_text: Select the correct statement regarding time duration of different events in the video

answer_options.text: Breakfast activities with the man and organizing the kitchen had the same time duration.

Tending to the plants outside took longer than interacting with technology.
Interacting with technology took longer than tending to the plants outside.
Both activities of preparing and cooking the meal and cleaning up after the meal took the same amount of time.
